composition.serve_who: Sheet 108-01-540-001 "BLACKWATER SYSTEM SCHEMATIC" documents the black (sewage) water system: all vessel toilets, showers-adjacent zone drawings (showers are grey water, shown for location context only, not part of this loop), two black water holding tanks (AFT 500L, FWD 400/620L), the discharge pumpset (2x Gianneschi MV44G pumps in the engine room), the anti-siphon manifold, tank level instrumentation, and dockside/overboard discharge fittings. Toilets flush TO the tanks (register node 540-wc-toilets); tank suction/discharge is via the 540-black-water-pumps (Gianneschi pump set, node 540-gianneschi-pumps for BOM identity); the tanks themselves have no dedicated register node found (integral tanks covered generically at 505-* for calibration/sensors only) so tank-specific facts are attached to 540-black-water-pumps as the system node per class rule, with cross-reference noted. Level switches/alarms feed tank instrumentation only (no separate monitoring node found for this specific alarm loop beyond San Giorgio sensor BOM at 505-san-giorgio-gas-monitoring-tank-sensors, which does NOT match — that node is gas monitoring; level switches here are 'San Giorgio S.E.I.N. TIL 40368' static level switches per BOM item 006, no dedicated node exists, so recorded as key components under 540-black-water-pumps).

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Black Water Discharge Pumpset (Gianneschi MV44G x2)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM item 001 identifies 'Blackwater Overboard Pump' as GIANNESCHI SRL KMV4401G / GIA-KMV4401G, matching the Gianneschi node directly by make/model in the BOM table.

functions.label: Blackwater Discharge Pump 1 & 2 (duty/standby pumpset)
functions.what_it_does: Two identical 24V DC motor-driven Gianneschi MV44G pumps mounted in the engine room, arranged in parallel with manual ball valves either side so either pump can be isolated/swapped as duty or standby. Each pump draws from the common black suction manifold (fed from AFT tank suction, FWD tank suction, or toilet direct-flush lines) and discharges through a set of NO/NC valves to either the dockside pump-out lines or the overboard fire-rated discharge line via the anti-siphon manifold.

flow_scenarios.path: Black suction manifold -> NO valve 004-02 -> Pump 1 (001-02) -> NO valve 004-04 -> NO valve 004-06 -> NO valve 004-07 -> overboard discharge / dock line
Black suction manifold -> NO valve 004-01 -> Pump 2 (001-01) -> NO valve 004-03 -> NO valve 004-05 -> crossover NC valve 004-08 (closed in normal ops) -> joins Pump 1 discharge line -> overboard/dock
Pump 2 discharge crosses via NC valve 004-08 into Pump 1 discharge run, allowing either pump to serve either outlet if one line is blocked
Discharge line -> fire-rated ISO 15540 pipe -> NO valve (below DWL) -> overboard fitting
Discharge routes through Anti-Siphon Manifold 700mm above DWL (item 007, SWS custom part) before overboard/dock connection, protecting against siphon back-flow when pump stops

key_components: NC crossover valve 004-08 (normally closed, emergency crossover)
Anti-siphon manifold (breather ref DWG 108-01-508-001) - back-flow/siphon protection
connection points (CP) either side of each pump for maintenance/instrumentation
functions.dry_data: Pump: Gianneschi MV44G, 24V DC, flow rate 50 l/min, power 0.3kW (per Pump Data table). Fittings 1-1/2" Cu-Ni per note. Fire-rated ISO15540 discharge pipe for below-DWL run.

functions.what_it_does: Each head's toilet uses an integral macerator/vortex discharge pump (Planus PW.02.00) to flush waste through sanitary hose into the nearest black tank (AFT or FWD depending on location) or, for the combined/crew heads, direct to the aft black tank via dedicated flush lines.

facts: AFT BLACK TANK: 500 L capacity, located amidships (frame ~7-8), fed by aft-zone toilets via sanitary hose, suction taken to discharge pumpset via 'AFT BLACK TANK SUCTION TO PUMP' line.

FWD BLACK TANK: labelled 620 (upper GA plan) and 400 L (lower schematic) - same tank, two views on this sheet; capacity per lower schematic BOM callout = 400L. Fed by fwd-zone toilets (Fwd Guest, Owners).
Each tank has a 3-contact static level switch assembly (BOM item 006, San Giorgio S.E.I.N. TIL 40368, 30V 1A): ALARM HIGH (audible alarm), TANK FULL (discharge required indication), TANK LOW.
Each tank has an instrument assembly (006-01 aft, 006-02 fwd) mounted on tank top, wired to a local Control Panel (CP) which also controls the associated discharge pump via NO/NC valve pairs.
Each tank has a breather/vent line referenced to a separate drawing '108-01-508-001 Tank Breathers Routing' - not detailed on this sheet (see drawing-specific note 2).
Tank connections use standard entry types per 'Tank Connections' legend: horizontal side entry (S), vertical top entry (T), vertical bottom entry (B), tank lid entry.

No dedicated tank equipment-register node found; tank facts recorded against the pump/system node 540-black-water-pumps per class rule (system node carries tank roster) - flag: consider requesting a tank node if register is expanded.

Anti-siphon manifold (BOM item 007, SWS custom part, qty 1) mounted 700mm above DWL, positioned between the discharge pumpset and the overboard/dock discharge lines - prevents back-siphoning of seawater into tanks/pumps when pump is off.
Separate small anti-siphon/breather valve (007-01) shown at the manifold outlet leading toward the fwd black tank suction area.
Siphon-break valve item 002 (BOM: GUIDI SRL ART 1250, qty 1, 185kg total) is the physical valve within the manifold assembly.

Two shore pump-out fittings: AFT (item 005-01) near frame L/K and FWD (item 005-02) near frame B/A, plus a third 'pump out fitting (location TBD)' at the stern lazarette area and one in the anchor bay - these are waste pump-out fittings (BOM item 005, GUIDI SRL ART 1182, qty 2 costed; additional shown are uncosted/TBD).
Aft Dock Discharge Line runs from aft pump-out fitting through the hull along frames L-H to the combined discharge line.
Fwd Dock Discharge Line runs from fwd pump-out fitting through frames C-F to the combined discharge line.
Combined Dock Discharge Line runs in the sheer (upper hull), connecting aft and fwd discharge runs - single continuous overboard/pump-out header serving both tanks.

Piping: fire-rated 40mm hose (th40, Iberica EasyFlex, ISO15540) used for overboard/fire-rated runs; sanitary 'no smell' hose sa25 (25mm) and sa38 (38mm) used for toilet-to-tank flush lines (Vetus SAHOSE25/38).
